newsitem.title: RUSSIA: British spy gets 10 years in Russian labour camp.
newsitem.headline: British spy gets 10 years in Russian labour camp.

text.p: Russia's top court sentenced a former Russian company manager to 10 years' hard labour and confiscated his property on Wednesday for spying for Britain.
A court official said Vadim Sintsov, 62, who was arrested in January 1994, pleaded guilty to providing British agents with information on the Russian arms industry.
The trial was conducted by the military bench of the Supreme Court, whose rulings are final and cannot be appealed.
The official said Sintsov,had been given a much lighter sentence than the maximum 20 years for "cooperating with the court".
Sintsov's lawyer praised the verdict, telling Russian Television: "The court was not only objective but ideal. The case was conducted on the highest judicial level."

Sintsov, in what appeared to be archive footage, was shown by the same channel saying: "They (the British) were interested in real-time information -- on the current state of deliveries and also in possible samples of new Russian military equipment."
